evals.prompt: What keywords do my competitors rank for that we don't? We are routergrowth.com in the US
assertions: Uses seo_competitors then seo_ranked_keywords on each side
Outputs a page plan sorted by priority
Calls get_operation_pricing before the first paid call of each tool
Sets max_cost on every paid call
Reports the total spent from list_runs

Uses seo_serp to read the winning page type
Calls get_operation_pricing before the first paid call of each tool
Sets max_cost on every paid call
Reports the total spent from list_runs

Calls get_operation_pricing before the first paid call of each tool
